title: Storage Provider Nodes and Nextcloud SDK Extraction

events.summary: Captured the storage-provider-node and Nextcloud SDK extraction design discussion. No implementation is authorized by this record.
User authorized implementation of the provider-node resolution on development.
Retired the provisional McpNode grammar in favor of separate McpTool and McpService configuration; next slice is direct typed-service injection.
Completed direct typed-service parameter injection and deterministic oneOf selection with focused scanner, registry, and invocation tests.
Added separate services/list discovery metadata and verified dispatch registration without exposing provider instances.

Verified the SDK adapter and provider-module migration boundary: Nextcloud uses the SDK client only inside toolspace, custom delegated OCS behavior remains a narrow provider-private adapter, and local storage has a separate module destination.

Extracted and distributed the Nextcloud provider module, removed native Nextcloud routing/configuration, verified services/list discovery, and preserved publication-status through provider-aware fallback without restoring ToolStorageRouter.

Extracted and distributed local workspace storage, removed native storage implementation and application property values, and made publication-status query registered providers. The remaining cleanup is migration of the legacy core storage binding DTO into the local module.
Added the generated tools-and-services documentation snapshot from public registry descriptors without serializing provider instances or credentials.
Separated provider declaration from tool-function injection: McpService is class-only and McpFunctionService now marks typed function parameters.
Added named display metadata to McpFunctionService and published it in function requirement discovery metadata.
Made McpFunctionService type optional by deriving its capability contract from the annotated function parameter when omitted.
Added the common service lifecycle, typed function-service client input schemas, and init/stop invocation bridging.
Corrected lifecycle input ownership: provider schemas now publish under requirement metadata and client values travel through tools/call params.requirements, separate from tool arguments.
Changed public tool requirement metadata from an array to a key-addressed object, keyed by the declared requirement key.
Passed the focused requirement discovery and lifecycle suite after the key-addressed metadata change.

Moved the residual core storage binding DTO into toolspace/local-storage as LocalStorageProperties, removed core provider configuration ownership, and verified focused module and server binding tests.
Replaced the opaque service lifecycle input bridge with optional concrete typed init methods scanned and bound like normal tool methods; focused lifecycle and discovery tests passed.
